sources.title: Manganese-electrolysed slag treatment: bioleaching of manganese by Fusarium sp.
sources.version: Publisher version of record; June 2012 issue 33(11):1307-1312; cover gives accepted-version online 20 September 2011; publisher metadata gives version of record online 13 January 2012.
sources.inspection: Seven PDF pages: cover plus six article pages. All text read; PDF pages 3-6 visually checked, containing methods and Figures 1-6. No main-text tables.
supporting_locators: Section 3.2.5 and Figure 6 operational BCR partitioning
limits: Solid mass/loading and feed pretreatment not adequately reported.
Biomass 0.044 g is described by the internally ambiguous phrase dry wet; use nominal inoculum fraction without assigning a dry-mass basis.
No pH-trajectory-matched abiotic comparison; organic acids explicitly hypothetical, not measured.
AAS elemental Mn does not establish dissolved oxidation state despite the source Mn2+ terminology.
No isolated-product mass balance, economics or deployment measured.
Figure 4 initial pH labels 4,6,7,8 conflict with prose upper bound 9.6.
The late decline is preserved; no universal 144 h monotonic increase claim.
Sequence naming conflicts with official deposit; no resolved species/strain identifier.

No supplement located in inspected article, indexed publisher material or exact DOI supplement query; publisher live full-text access returned 403, so comprehensive supplement absence is not established.
sources.license: Copyright 2012 Taylor & Francis; PDF cover permits research/teaching/private study and restricts redistribution. Raw PDF and rendered pages remain outside Git.
